metadata.description: A repo-agnostic workflow library for Claude Code: one front door, a project wiki, and model-routed dispatch.

plugins.name: personal-skills
plugins.description: One front door for work in any repo. /orchestrate ensures a corpus/ workspace, reads corpus/routing.md, and routes capture to corpus-flow (LLM-maintained wiki + briefs lifecycle), build to plan-split-dispatch (hard chunks to opus, easy to sonnet), questions to the wiki. Plus corpus-docs-site (Starlight docs generated from the corpus and the TypeScript), init-personal-repo (wire a repo in via a managed CLAUDE.md block), a research/understanding trio (web-research, codegraph, performance-analysis), grill-me, ui-test-plans, and bootstrap-vps-deploy.
